Indian junior badminton teams face losses in separate tournaments

India's junior badminton teams experienced defeats in recent competitions. The national team lost to Hong Kong in the quarterfinals of the Badminton Asia Junior Team Championships. Separately, Hazel Joshi achieved a victory in the U-13 quarterfinals of the Maharashtra Sub-Junior Badminton Selection Tournament.
